user.title: Wellbeing Tracker
user.description: Adds a dashboard card, sensors for each person and medication, and actions to answer reminders and log doses. Everything comes from the Wellbeing Tracker app, which is already running.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the Wellbeing Tracker app. Check it's running, then try again.

abort.already_configured: Wellbeing Tracker is already set up.
abort.no_app: Install and start the Wellbeing Tracker app first. It sets this up for you.

answer_reminder.name: Answer a reminder
answer_reminder.description: Answers a Wellbeing reminder, the same as tapping its button on your phone.

reminder_id.name: Reminder
reminder_id.description: The reminder's number, from the Reminders waiting sensor.

answer.name: Answer
answer.description: taken, snooze or skip. Mood and water buttons work too, for example MOOD_7 or WATER_1.

log_dose.name: Log a dose
log_dose.description: Logs a medication as taken now. It counts towards a reminder that's due and comes off the supply.

medication.name: Medication
medication.description: Its name, as in the Wellbeing app.

quantity.name: How many
quantity.description: Leave empty for the usual amount.

person.name: Person
person.description: Who took it. Leave empty for whoever runs the action.

log.name: Log a rating
log.description: Logs a rating such as Mood or Energy, as of now.

value.name: Value
value.description: For example 8 on a 1 to 10 scale.

person.name: Person
person.description: Who it's for. Leave empty for whoever runs the action.

im_up.name: I'm up
im_up.description: Tells Wellbeing someone has got up, so medications due "when I wake up" are due now. Only the first one each day counts.

person.name: Person
person.description: Who's up. Leave empty for whoever runs the action (or the only person).

at.name: When
at.description: When they got up, if earlier than now. Must be today.

source.name: How you know
source.description: A few words, such as "phone off charger". Optional.

init.title: Awake and asleep
init.description: Whose Awake switch do you want to set up?

person.title: Awake and asleep: {name}
person.description: The **Awake** switch on {name}'s Wellbeing device turns off when they're most likely asleep and on when they're up. Use it in automations for "when I wake up" and "when I fall asleep"; waking up also counts for medications due when you're up. It can always be flipped by hand. Leave anything you don't have empty.

data_description.sleep_tracking: Sleep as Android's Sleep tracking event. Starting it means asleep; until it stops, only leaving home or the charger can mean awake.
data_description.charging: Coming off charge after a night's charge means awake. On charge at bedtime helps tell you're asleep when you don't track.
data_description.phone_locked: Unlocking the phone and using it for a while means awake. Only a fresh unlock counts, so a phone left unlocked overnight doesn't.
data_description.activity: The phone noticing walking or running means awake.
data_description.person: Leaving home means awake. Away from home is never asleep by the bedtime rule.
data_description.lights: With no sleep tracking: home, phone on charge and these off, quiet for a while, means asleep.
data_description.signs: Things that only happen once you're up: a computer unlocking, the dishwasher or fridge opening, the kettle drawing power. Each counts when it turns on, opens or unlocks, or a power sensor goes over 20 W.
data_description.keep_awake: Never asleep by the bedtime rule while any of these is on, such as your computer or the TV.
data_description.earliest: Nothing counts as waking up before this (except leaving home and the switch itself).
data_description.bedtime_after: The bedtime rule (no sleep tracking) applies from this time...
data_description.night_charge_hours: Charging at least this long counts as a night on charge, not a top-up.
data_description.in_use_minutes: Unlocked this long counts as being up.
data_description.quiet_minutes: With no sleep tracking: how long everything has to be quiet before it counts as asleep.
data_description.bedtime_until: ...until this time, for late nights. Waking up still can't happen before the earliest wake-up.

abort.no_people: Nobody uses Wellbeing yet. Open the app once, then come back.
